images.title: An agent trace and the fields extracted into its test case
images.alt: An agent trace for a refund agent with an LLM planning span, a retriever with an embedding span, a search_orders tool call, an issue_refund call that timed out and its retry, a billing sub-agent with its own LLM span and a final answer. The tool calls are extracted into tools_called and the final answer into actual_output on the agent’s test case.
